svg.title: example’s GitHub constellation
svg.desc: 12 public repositories arranged in a deterministic force layout. Solid lines connect projects through selected languages; detected languages include secondary languages; dotted bridges join nearby groups visually and do not represent dependencies. 12 of 12 shared connections shown. Brighter paths emphasize nearby relationships; faint paths preserve the remaining selected overlaps. Star size reflects GitHub stars. Identity rings are seeded by the account name; ring points provide placement anchors for nodes. telescope, constellation, signal, orbit-core, stargazer, sky-map, night-sky, observatory, tiny-world, moonrise, atlas, starship. Recent public coding activity is most concentrated around 22:00–02:00 (America/New_York), based on available events in the last 30 days.
